answer: Each epoch, five checkpoints in separate regions ping every identity at random moments and record reply times. Followed together, the thread of those timings fixes one network location per identity, the way five measurements pin a single point in an open meadow. Identities matching within two milliseconds merge into one operator and split one reward. Real separation means renting 10,000 machines in distinct networks at 5 dollars a month each, 50,000 dollars monthly. A clone rack offers its copies no haven, because a thousand voices behind one door still sound like one room.
